description_sq:

Apartamenti ka 3 orientime,Veri,perendim dhe jug.
Siperfaqja e madhe dhe ndarja planimetrike qe ka, krijon mundesine per tu kthyer fare lehte ne 3+1.
Bashke me apartamentin,ofrohen dhe dy poste parkimi me cmim ekstra.

Per sa i perket Objektit,Gradient Rezidence është një vend ideal për ata që kërkojnë një jetese komode, me lehtësi për tu lidhur me qytetin dhe Parkun e Liqenit.Objekti eshte I ndare ne 2 shkalle ku secila disponon 2 ashensore te markes SCHINDLER me kapacitet prej 9 personash.
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone mund te na kontaktoni.
title_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale at Gradient Residence
description_en: Apartment for sale with a total area of ​​195.62 m2 in the Gradient Residence between the Zoo and the Dry Lake. The apartment is located on the 5th floor of the residence, and is organized in two rooms, two bathrooms, and a large living room that opens onto the large veranda with an area of ​​32.67 m2, which offers a fantastic view of the lake of Tirana. The apartment has 3 orientations, North, West and South. The large area and the planimetric division that it has, creates the possibility to easily turn into a 3+1. Along with the apartment, two parking spaces are offered at an extra cost. The apartment is ready for delivery in September 2026. Regarding the building, Gradient Residence is an ideal place for those looking for a comfortable life, easily connected to the city and the Lake Park. The building is divided into 2 stairs, each of which has 2 SCHINDLER elevators with a capacity of 9 people. For more information or a visit to the property, you can contact us.
